integrity: The compactness side was reconstructed from the published strict interpolation theorem and the Hilbert interpolation identity; endpoint failure and supercritical blow-up were proved directly by a fixed-operator eigenmode sequence. No numerical experiment, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive self-adjoint compact-resolvent operators on infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces, finite intervals, and fractional-domain exponents between zero and one. It does not cover non-self-adjoint sectorial scales or pointwise-in-time compactness. An equivalent endpoint-obstruction theorem under older Sobolev--Lions terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact compactness threshold for intermediate Morrey derivatives on compact-resolvent Hilbert scales
